source.title: Ballymena Observer, 8 June 1967, p. 8 ("County and rural election results: Ballymena Rural"); Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (printed as the Ballymena Times), 8 June 1967, p. 14 ("Ballymena Rural District Council: notice of result of elections")
source.publisher: Ballymena Observer (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read on the page images: the Ballymena Observer report prints Dickey 484, Davison 262, majority 222, 746 votes cast of an electorate of 1,117 (484 + 262 = 746); the returning officer's notice in the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph prints the same 262 and 484.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. The Galgorm division was the only contest; the other divisions were filled unopposed. The Longmore return, not legible in the Ballymena Observer's printing of the notice, is taken from the same notice in the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14. Dickey, the sitting member, returned; majority 222; electorate 1,117, 746 votes cast (67 per cent), two spoiled (Ballymena Observer).
correctionNote: Corrected from the page images of the Ballymena Observer, 8 June 1967, p. 8 and the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 8 June 1967, p. 14 (council-audit, Nov 2026): James Davison polled 262 (was 202; the printed majority is 222 and 484 + 262 = 746 votes cast), and the notice is cited under its own paper's name (it is the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, printed as the Ballymena Times, not the Ballymena Observer).
